promql.promql:
group by (name) (csv_succeeded{_id="", name=~"gpu-operator-certified[.].*"})
or on (_id)
0 * group(csv_count{_id=""})

records.name: CgroupV1ForcedMigration
records.message: Clusters running cgroupv1 may experience forced migration to cgroupv2 due to a missing RBAC role in the Machine Config Operator, causing application failures for workloads not yet compatible with cgroupv2. The fix is available in 4.18.56. Remediation for affected versions is documented in https://access.redhat.com/solutions/7147961
